createodometer.configuration.title: Create: Odometer Configuration
createodometer.configuration.minimumSpee: Ignore movement below this speed to suppress parked jitter. Very slow travel is also excluded.
createodometer.configuration.maximumPlau: Reject physics-step jumps above this speed. This does not limit vehicle speed.
createodometer.configuration.allowTripRe: Allow nearby players to reset trips. Operators can always reset them.
createodometer.configuration.displaySync: Refresh gauge readings every this many game ticks. Mileage tracking still runs every physics step.
createodometer.configuration.units.toolt: Your local display units for all gauges and menus. One block is treated as one meter.
createodometer.configuration.decimalPlac: Number of decimal places shown in gauge readings (0–3).
